messages:
carmen: Heads-up from prod: customer `acme-inc` saw a provisional credits spike + alert after a streaming tool_call retry loop. Looks like we wrote two provisional rows for the same logical session.

carmen: Repro (from logs):
```
req=abc123 client=acme session=session-77 event=stream.start provisional=40 prov_id=pv-100
req=abc123 client=acme event=client-retry reason=timeout new_req=abc123-1 session=session-77 event=stream.start provisional=40 prov_id=pv-101
...router does handoff... finalizer consolidates and confirms confirmed=36 final_id=fn-77
```

liam: Oof. So provisional duplicates because client retried without idempotency. Do the prov rows include any linking metadata (original_req / parent_id)?

carmen: No, current provisional write is small: {session, prov_id, route_tag, amount, timestamp}. No parent pointer.

aisha: That's rough. Two problems: (1) console and alerts count provisional total naively, and (2) we can't unambiguously join which provisional(s) map to the final.

eric: Quick mitigation: change alerting to de-dupe provisional spikes by session_id for a short window. That'll reduce noise while we design a durable fix.

liam: For a durable fix I propose: router must attach `idempotency_key` (generated by client or by edge) and when a provisional write happens, we upsert on (session_id, idempotency_key). Also store `prov_parent` that points to prior provisional if router chooses to fork.

aisha: If client can't provide idempotency_key reliably for streaming resumes, router should synthesise a `handoff_token` that persists across retries. We already have a session uuid — maybe use that as the canonical key instead of request id.

carmen: Note: in this incident the client reused the same session but the requests had slightly different transport ids; session was present though. So using session-based de-dupe would have prevented double provisional. But other flows have multi-session fanout so be cautious.

eric: DB change: add `session_key` (string), `idempotency_key` (nullable), and `prov_parent_id` (nullable) to `stream_provisional`. This keeps rows flat. Finalizer will then walk prov rows grouped by session_key and idempotency_key.

liam: Finalizer behavior: when confirming, prefer single prov that matches idempotency_key; if multiple provs present for same session and no idempotency, merge them (sum or take latest?) then emit telemetry about merge. We should prefer latest timestamp and recompute confirmed amount vs sum — semantics TBD.

aisha: UI/console change: collapse provisional rows by session_key and show a small "merged" badge with hover explaining retries/fork. Also change alert rule to use merged provisional totals.

carmen: Telemetry proposal: emit `stream.provisional_written` with {prov_id, session_key, idempotency_key, route, amount}, `stream.provisional_merged` with {merged_ids, final_candidate_id}, and `stream.confirmed` as today. That will make posthoc joins straightforward.

eric: Ops-bot: created INF-2456 for follow-up + staging test harness. Assignees: @liam, @aisha. https://issues/redwood/INF-2456

liam: Implementation plan: 1) short-term alert de-dupe (eric), 2) router pass session_key / handoff_token (liam), 3) DB add session_key/idempotency/prov_parent + finalizer merge logic (liam + aisha), 4) console collapse UX (carmen). Target: next sprint for backend pieces; console after.

aisha: I'll add a deterministic replay test in staging that simulates client retry + truncated toolcall to validate merge heuristics.

carmen: Thanks. If this pops in prod again, tag `incident:provisional-dup` and ping #oncall.

eric: +1 :thumbsup:
